scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory apps/api python -m scripts.export_openapi && npm run gen:api -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.lint:api: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run --directory apps/api ruff format . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check --fix . && npm run format -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: uv run --directory apps/api mypy && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:api: npm run db:up && uv run --directory apps/api pytest -n 4
scripts.check: node scripts/with-lock.mjs check npm run check:steps
